record.name: Sentinel
record.description: Sentinels are balanced Force-wielders who combine diplomacy, investigation, and combat skills. They serve as mediators, investigators, and protectors, using their connection to the Force to maintain balance and uncover hidden truths.

dynamic_visuals.combat_stance: Assumes a defensive stance, lightsaber glowing in hand as they circle around their foe.
dynamic_visuals.energy_signature: Surrounded by an aura of blue and green Force energy, crackling with the power of the living Force.

progression_path.emergence: The Sentinel stumbles upon a hidden truth about their past, forcing them to confront the implications.
progression_path.escalation: As they investigate further, they inadvertently threaten the interests of powerful figures who will stop at nothing to silence them.
progression_path.confrontation: With no other choice, the Sentinel must face off against these adversaries in a final showdown to protect themselves and others.

resolution_paths.victory: The Sentinel successfully exposes the truth and brings justice to those responsible, earning their respect and admiration.
resolution_paths.redemption: Through self-reflection and determination, the Sentinel is able to redeem themselves and make amends for past mistakes.
resolution_paths.escape: In a narrow escape, the Sentinel manages to flee from their pursuers and regroup before continuing their mission.

conflict_triggers: Challenges to authority or social order

romance_progression.stage1: The Sentinel is drawn to their romantic interest, but struggles to balance their feelings with their duties as a mediator and protector.
romance_progression.stage2: As the relationship deepens, the Sentinel must navigate the challenges of maintaining intimacy while also dealing with the stresses of their role.
romance_progression.stage3: With increased familiarity, the Sentinel begins to question whether they can truly trust their partner amidst the dangers and uncertainties of their work.
romance_progression.stage4: The Sentinel's romantic interest is drawn into the conflicts surrounding their role, forcing them to confront the personal costs of their actions.
romance_progression.stage5: In a moment of crisis, the Sentinel must choose between their duty to protect others and their love for their partner.

lifestyle_challenges: Inherent dangers of the job (e.g. getting hurt or killed)
Pressure from both the Jedi Order and personal interests to prioritize duties over relationships

record.flavor_text: A guardian of peace and justice, Sentinels wield the power of the Force to protect and serve. Their connection to the living Force guides them in times of turmoil.

llm_guidance.roleplay_guidance: Play a mediator who seeks to resolve conflicts through understanding and empathy. Balance diplomacy with tactical prowess.
narrative_hooks: A group of smugglers has stolen sensitive data from a key Imperial facility.
Rumors of a Sith cult operating on the outskirts of the galaxy have come to light.
The New Republic is at odds with the Jedi Order over resource allocation and territory control.
llm_guidance.social_dynamics: Establish yourself as a trusted authority, then use your influence to shape events and bring balance to the Force.

ai_behavior.combat_behavior: Engage at a safe distance with blaster and Force abilities.
ai_behavior.social_behavior: Engage in calm, measured speech. Use persuasion to resolve conflicts peacefully.

trust_levels.low: Betrayal is expected; take action to prevent it.
trust_levels.medium: Monitor interactions for signs of betrayal or deception.
trust_levels.high: Act as a trusted ally and friend.
